title: Normal Lod Input Row Connection Hitbox
description: On normal LOD, hide handle dots and use the full input row as the hitbox for wire connections.
summary: At normal LOD, handle dots are no longer painted (`shows_handles` now gates detail/micro only). Pointer hit-testing remaps clicks inside computation input-column rows to the matching input handle so wire drag, drop, and reconnect work across the full row width instead of a tiny rim dot.
